evidence: Col. 7.8.7: (cāseus) vel manū figūrātur vel buxeīs fōrmīs exprimitur (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 36.168: fōrmae in quibus aera funduntur (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The classical word for a mould that gives a thing its shape: cheese is pressed in boxwood moulds and bronze cast in them (Lewis & Short). What the mould is for is said with ad and the gerundive, as in the example.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. mold.
